entries.title: Song of Solomon 5:1
segments: ¶I have come into my garden, my sister, my bride; to take my myrrh with my spice; my wax with my honey; my wine with my milk. Take meat, O friends; take wine, yes, be overcome with love.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 5:2
segments: ¶I am sleeping, but my heart is awake; it is the sound of my loved one at the door, saying, Be open to me, my sister, my love, my dove, my very beautiful one; my head is wet with dew, and my hair with the drops of the night.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 5:3
segments: I have put off my coat; how may I put it on? My feet are washed; how may I make them unclean?

entries.title: Song of Solomon 5:4
segments: My loved one put his hand on the door, and my heart was moved for him.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 5:5
segments: I got up to let my loved one in; and my hands were dropping with myrrh, and my fingers with liquid myrrh, on the lock of the door.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 5:6
segments: I made the door open to my loved one; but my loved one had taken himself away, and was gone, my soul was feeble when his back was turned on me; I went after him, but I did not come near him; I said his name, but he gave me no answer.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 5:7
segments: The keepers who go about the town overtook me; they gave me blows and wounds; the keepers of the walls took away my veil from me.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 5:8
segments: I say to you, O daughters of Jerusalem, if you see my loved one, what will you say to him? That I am overcome with love.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 5:9
segments: ¶What is your loved one more than another, O fairest among women? What is your loved one more than another, that you say this to us?

entries.title: Song of Solomon 5:10
segments: My loved one is white and red, the chief among ten thousand.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 5:11
segments: His head is as the most delicate gold; his hair is thick, and black as a raven.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 5:12
segments: His eyes are as the eyes of doves by the water streams, washed with milk, and rightly placed.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 5:13
segments: His face is as beds of spices, giving out perfumes of every sort; his lips like lilies, dropping liquid myrrh.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 5:14
segments: His hands are as rings of gold ornamented with beryl-stones; his body is as a smooth plate of ivory covered with sapphires.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 5:15
segments: His legs are as pillars of stone on a base of delicate gold; his looks are as Lebanon, beautiful as the cedar-tree.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 5:16
segments: His mouth is most sweet; yes, he is all beautiful. This is my loved one, and this is my friend, O daughters of Jerusalem.
